name: Breaker close-pulse shaping
summary: Converts a maintained supervisory request into the documented finite closing pulse.
description: Converts a maintained supervisory request into the documented finite closing pulse. A closing circuit combines an operator or automatic request with the conditions that allow the breaker to close. The closing coil releases stored mechanism energy where that construction is used; it is different from the spring-charging motor.

In a switchgear bus-coupler panel, a close request is checked against position, mechanism readiness and the selected live-bus or dead-bus conditions before the closing circuit is enabled. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Maintained control request” at the input and “Bounded close pulse” at the output. Pulse width is set by the equipment design.

Follow request, permission and final coil output as separate signals. A permissive diagram must say which conditions block closing and what happens if a feedback signal becomes unavailable. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
